newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices ease in lower volume.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices ease in lower volume.

text.p: Prices fell on the Istanbul gold exchange in lira terms in line with European trends and with the help of a firmer lira, dealers said.
There was no dollar trade and volume dropped due to weaker free market demand, they added.
Gold closed at 1,162,250 lira per gram, down from 1,164,000 on Wednesday. The lira ended at 94,670 against the dollar on the interbank after yesterday's 94,680.
The last close in dollar terms was $382.00 an ounce at noon on Wednesday.
Traded volume was 803 kilos, all done in lira, after 902 on Wednesday. The bulk of the turnover was done in the morning at 663 kilos. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-275 08 75
